definitions.explanation: The state of working too much or too hard. Formed from {働|はたら}く (to work) plus the suffix 〜{過|す}ぎ (excess, too much).

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Overwork is bad for your health.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Lately I'm tired from working too much.

examples.japanese: {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Some people collapse because of overwork.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧ (to work) plus the suffix 〜⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧, which attaches to verb stems to mean 'doing too much'.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{倒|たお}れる→倒れる：01160_taoreru⟧: to collapse from overwork
- {働|はたら}き{過|す}ぎ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent overwork

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{過労|かろう}→過労：08563_karou⟧: overwork — more clinical and formal, as in ⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧ (death from overwork)
- ⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ→食べ過ぎ：28819_tabesugi⟧: overeating — the same 〜{過|す}ぎ pattern
